data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'adriános', meaning 'dark one' or 'man from Adriatic'. In Greek mythology, Adrastos was a nobleman from Argos who led the Seven against Thebes. Adriane may evoke images of strength, courage, and determination. The name Adriane carries the meaning “Dark one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Adriane usually hope their child will grow to embody dark one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
